---
title: Scrollable regions
format: html
---

Fixture for #14378: the scrollable-regions runtime makes code blocks and
cell output keyboard-focusable (`tabindex`/`role`/`aria-label`) only while
they actually overflow. Every wide element below overflows a 390px viewport
and fits a 1440px one.

## Wide code block {#wide-code}

```python
wide_code = "an_unbroken_token_that_cannot_wrap_and_overflows_mobile"
```

## Output containing a link {#has-link}

A region the user can already tab into must not gain a second tab stop.

:::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output-display}

| Sepal.Length | Sepal.Width | Petal.Length | Petal.Width | Species | Observer | Source |
|-------------:|------------:|-------------:|------------:|:--------|:---------|:-------|
|          5.1 |         3.5 |          1.4 |         0.2 | setosa  | RAF      | [ref](https://example.com) |

:::
::::

## Numbered code block {#numbered}

Pandoc emits a focusable fragment link per numbered line. Those links cannot
scroll the block sideways, so it still needs a region tab stop of its own.

```{.python code-line-numbers="true"}
numbered_code = "an_unbroken_token_that_cannot_wrap_and_overflows_mobile"
```

## Visually hidden alternative {#visually-hidden}

Mirrors the quarto-web get-started markup: a `visually-hidden` code
alternative for screen readers. It is clipped to 1px, so its content height
reads as overflow. It must not become an invisible tab stop.

```{=html}
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb-vh"><pre class="sourceCode yaml visually-hidden code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode yaml">project:
  type: website
  output-dir: _site
  an_unbroken_token_that_cannot_wrap_and_overflows_the_container_width_easily</code></pre></div>
```
